name: DKAN Geo Widget
description: A Leaflet + Geoman map widget for DKAN JSON-schema form fields that saves drawn markers and shapes as GeoJSON.
project_description: The DKAN Geo Widget module provides a Leaflet + Leaflet-Geoman based map widget for DKAN's JSON-schema form UI. Editors draw markers and shapes on an OpenStreetMap-backed map and the module serializes them to GeoJSON, storing the result in the related schema field (for example the dataset 'spatial' property). It restores the DKAN D7 Leaflet widget feature for the DKAN 2.x metastore. The widget is wired in by decorating json_form_widget's WidgetRouter (and, when present, dkan_group's widget router); it is selected by setting 'dkan_geo_widget' as the widget key for a property in the .ui schema (dataset.ui.json). Requires DKAN and the standalone json_form_widget module.
